title: 12 Best Traditional Gondola Boatyards in Venice
description: Discover Venice's authentic gondola boatyards (squeri). Explore historic workshops, witness expert craftsmanship, and learn about the iconic Venetian gondola's rich heritage.

places.name: Squero di San Trovaso
places.priceRange: Free (view from outside), €15-30 for guided tours (by appointment) / $16-32 USD
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A guided tour (check availability via local tour operators) to learn about the intricate construction process.

places.name: Squero Tramontin & Figli
places.priceRange: By appointment, private tour costs vary, typically €80-150 / $85-160 USD per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Arrange a private, guided visit to witness their unmatched dedication to historical accuracy and craftsmanship firsthand.

places.name: Museo Storico Navale di Venezia (and Padiglione delle Navi)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dedicate time to both the main museum and the Padiglione delle Navi for the full historical context.

places.name: Arzanà (Associazione per la Salvaguardia delle Barche Tradizionali Veneziane)
places.priceRange: Membership/Event dependent, free for external views, workshops €50-100+ / $55-110+ USD
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their website for upcoming events, demonstrations, or short courses on traditional boatbuilding or rowing.

places.name: Vento di Venezia (Isola di Certosa)
places.priceRange: Boat tours/experiences start from €100 / $110 USD, workshops vary
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Participate in a traditional Venetian rowing lesson or inquire about their restoration workshops for a deeper dive.

places.name: Squero Dionisio
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order While direct public access is limited, some specialized walking tours of Castello may offer views or historical context of this working squero.

places.name: Squero della Pietà
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy the view from the nearby bridge; it's a great spot for photography and observing daily boatyard activities without intrusion.

places.name: Squero Vecio (Calle del Squero Vecio)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take a self-guided walk through the historical Castello district, paying attention to architectural details that might indicate former squeri locations.

places.name: Squero Lazzarin
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take a day trip to Pellestrina, walk or cycle along the Murazzi, and observe the squero's activity from the adjacent canal.

places.name: Squero di San Nicolò
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Combine a visit to this squero with a bike ride around the Lido, exploring its beaches and art nouveau architecture.

places.name: Squero di San Giorgio Maggiore
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take a vaporetto ride around Giudecca or across the Bacino di San Marco for the best views of the working waterfronts.

places.name: Squero di Ca' Foscari
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire with Ca' Foscari University departments (e.g., environmental sciences, cultural heritage) for any public lectures, workshops, or exhibitions related to traditional Venetian boats.
